name: LAVENTRA
tagline: The Black Velvet Enigma. Bold, aristocratic, and fiercely magnetic.
description: Draped in tactile midnight black velvet and crowned with a knurled gold cap, LAVENTRA by VELOCEES DE SCENT is an olfactory statement of commanding presence. Woven from high-altitude French lavender, smoky Haitian vetiver, crushed black pepper, and warm amber resin.

notes.top: French High-Altitude Lavender, Crushed Black Pepper, Italian Bergamot
notes.heart: Smoked Haitian Vetiver, Nutmeg, Leather Accord
notes.base: Precious Amber, Tonka Bean Coeur, Cedarwood

occasion: Evening Galas, High-Stakes Meetings & Nights Out

name: UNSPOKEN
tagline: Some things are felt, never spoken. Seductive, warm, and intoxicating.
description: Encased in rich royal bordeaux wine velvet, UNSPOKEN by VELOCEES DE SCENT whispers secrets of forbidden romance and nocturnal passion. A hypnotic harmony of crimson damask roses, warm spiced amber, and Madagascar bourbon vanilla.

notes.top: Crushed Saffron, Candied Plum, Sweet Mandarin Sparkle
notes.heart: Crimson Damask Rose Velvet, Warm Cinnamon, Golden Incense
notes.base: Madagascar Bourbon Vanilla, Ambergris, Cashmere Woods

occasion: Date Nights, Romantic Evenings & Special Milestones

name: OUD ROYALE
tagline: The Sovereign Scent of Kings. Smoky Cambodian Oud meets Golden Frankincense.
description: Cloaked in deep regal emerald green velvet, OUD ROYALE is an imperial fragrance crafted for individuals of sovereign power. Distilled from rare aged Cambodian agarwood, charred guaiacwood, royal frankincense, and liquid golden amber.

notes.top: Green Cardamom Pods, Pink Peppercorn, Wild Thyme
notes.heart: Smoked Cambodian Oud, Charred Guaiacwood, Golden Frankincense
notes.base: Royal Ambergris, Dark Birch Tar, Atlas Mountain Cedar

occasion: Royalty Galas, Red Carpets & Private Celebrations

name: AZUR IMPERIAL
tagline: Deep Oceanic Radiance. Crisp Mediterranean Sea Salt, Frosted Mint & Blue Sage.
description: Draped in midnight royal navy blue velvet, AZUR IMPERIAL captures the untamed majesty of Mediterranean night waters. An invigorating blast of sparkling Sicilian bergamot and wild sea salt softens into frosted mint and solar woods.

notes.top: Sunlit Sicilian Bergamot, Crushed Frosted Mint, Sea Breeze Accord
notes.heart: Blue Coastal Sage, Geranium Bourbon, Violet Leaves
notes.base: French Oakmoss, Sheer Ambroxan, Sun-Bleached Cedar

occasion: Daily Luxury, Yachting, Boardroom Meetings & Summer Evenings

name: ROSE VELOURS
tagline: Velvet Petals at Twilight. Turkish Rose Absolu steeped in Spiced Praline.
description: Enveloped in delicate dusty rose blush velvet, ROSE VELOURS is a poetic ode to Parisian romance. Unfolding with dewy May rosebuds and sweet lychee, it melts into decadent caramel praline and powdered cashmere musk.

notes.top: Dewy Grasse Rosebuds, Spiced Lychee Nectar, Italian Mandarin
notes.heart: Turkish Rose Absolu, Caramelized Praline Coeur, Peony
notes.base: Warm White Musk, Cashmere Woods, Golden Benzoin

occasion: Spring Brunches, Romantic Strolls & Candlelit Dinners

name: AMBRE D'OR
tagline: Sun-drenched Golden Warmth. Resinous Baltic Amber, Honeycomb & Smoked Tonka.
description: Swathed in rich cognac caramel velvet, AMBRE D'OR glows with molten golden decadence. An intoxicating blend of sweet wildflower honey, ancient Baltic amber resin, toasted almond tonka, and creamy vanilla bourbon.

notes.top: Wild Mountain Honey, Cinnamon Bark, Bitter Orange Zest
notes.heart: Resinous Baltic Amber, Toasted Tonka Bean, Labdanum
notes.base: Bourbon Vanilla, Cashmeran, Smoked Benzoin Tears

occasion: Autumn Evenings, Fireside Conversations & Luxury Soirées

name: IRIS NOIR
tagline: The Velvet Royalty of Florence. Powdery Tuscan Orris, Black Violet & Suede.
description: Draped in imperial royal amethyst purple velvet, IRIS NOIR is an aristocratic perfume of unmatched refinement. Built around prized Florentine orris butter aged for three years, framed by midnight violet petals and supple leather.

notes.top: Midnight Violet Petals, Candied Blackcurrant, Pink Pepper
notes.heart: Florentine Orris Butter, Heliotrope, Black Leather
notes.base: Indonesian Patchouli, Sheer White Suede, Madagascar Vanilla

occasion: Opera Nights, Art Exhibitions & Couture Evenings

name: SANTAL BLANC
tagline: Pure Sacred Serenity. Creamy Mysore Sandalwood enveloped in White Coconut & Musk.
description: Encased in pure ivory silk cream velvet, SANTAL BLANC evokes meditative peace and clean luxury. Creamy Indian sandalwood is whipped with white cardamom, silky coconut milk, green violet leaf, and luminous cedar.

notes.top: White Cardamom, Silky Coconut Water, Crushed Fig Leaves
notes.heart: Creamy Mysore Sandalwood Coeur, Iris Root, Violet Leaf
notes.base: Clean Sheer Musk, Iso E Super, Virginian Cedarwood

occasion: Morning Meditations, High-End Casual Wear & Daily Elegance
